title: Raise a ServiceNow request
summary: Generic way to order something from the ServiceNow catalogue and get it approved. Other processes use this as a sub-process.

prerequisites.title: ServiceNow account
prerequisites.description: You can log in with your company SSO account.

prerequisites.title: Cost centre number
prerequisites.description: Ask your line manager if you do not know it.

actors.name: You
actors.description: The engineer or BA following this process.

actors.name: Line manager
actors.description: Approves requests raised by their team.

actors.name: Fulfilment team
actors.description: The team that delivers the ordered item.

steps.title: Find the catalogue item
instructions: Search for the item name given in the parent process.
Open the item and check the description matches what you need.

steps.title: Fill in and submit the request
steps.description: Complete every mandatory field. Vague requests are the main reason for rejection.
instructions: Fill in all mandatory fields (marked with *).
In 'Business justification' write one sentence on why you need it.

steps.title: Fix and resubmit the request
instructions: Read the rejection comment on the request.
Correct the request or add the missing information.

steps.title: Confirm you got what you ordered
instructions: If not, reopen the request within 5 days.
